verdict: Paid ads have been off for 24 days; reactivation is the immediate priority.
narrative: Meta advertising stopped on September 15th and has run no spend for 24 consecutive days, which is the direct reason zero paid leads were recorded this period — this is a spend absence, not a performance problem with the ads themselves. Organic visibility has also softened: Google Business Profile actions dropped 74% week-over-week, and Instagram reach went to zero over the last 10 days. On a more encouraging note, your CRM shows 179 contacts and 9 opportunities created this period, valued at $385.60 — meaning some patient interest is coming through, though those opportunities have not yet converted and the pipeline needs follow-up attention. Paid campaigns are being reactivated this week, and we're addressing the open opportunities in your intake flow to reduce drop-off before the next reporting period.

highlights.phrase: consecutive days with no ad spend, driving the zero paid-lead count this period
organic Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and site clicks
new opportunities in your pipeline this period, currently stalled and being followed up

watch_item.issue: Nine pipeline opportunities created this period have not converted and show no appointments booked, pointing to a gap in the intake follow-up process.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the intake sequence this week to identify where leads are dropping off and tighten the follow-up steps.
